label: Dickson 2012
setting: ambulatory office of a family medicine residency program (primary care; Wichita KS)
recruitment: consecutive-style: all patients presenting for care May-June 2011 who were 50+ and met inclusion criteria were approached; no cognitive or physical deficit impairing the tasks; $15 gift card; stopped at 69 enrolled; 23 randomised to each of 3 tests by drawing sealed envelopes
instruments: Functional Vision Screening Questionnaire; Mixed contrast sensitivity reading card; Snellen eye chart
notes: Time-to-administer study only; no accuracy data (paper states reliability to detect visual impairment was not assessed p4). 23 per arm; each participant did only one test. Questionnaire completed unassisted in private room (p2); card and Snellen administered by research assistant/standard practice (p2). time_to_administer_min = 186 s / 60 for the questionnaire (Table 2 p3). Age mean/SD/range and 77% female from Results p3. Language not stated.
